_note: Global game settings, start state and timers. Times are in hours unless a key says minutes.
title: Mysteryless Island

log: Awake. Salt in the mouth. The sea is quiet now. The ship is gone. Behind the dunes, a dark line of trees.
Cold sand under your cheek. Salt on your lips. The sea is flat, grey and empty: no ship. Beyond the dunes, a dark line of trees.
You come to at the tide line, clothes heavy with water. Nothing on the horizon, nothing left of the ship. Behind the dunes, trees.

_sleep: Every sleep ends at 06:00. At zero energy or 00:00, unfinished work stops and you collapse here.

collapse.title: You passed out
collapse.text: You did not get to bed in time. You passed out and had to sleep where you were, at {place}.

sleep.midnight: It is midnight. You can no longer stay awake and pass out where you are.
sleep.exhausted: Your energy is gone. You collapse where you are and sleep until morning.

early_warm_bed.text: You went to sleep before midnight in a sheltered bed at {place}, with a fire burning. You wake at 6am with {energy}% energy.

early_unheated_bed.text: You went to sleep before midnight in a sheltered bed at {place}, without a burning fire. You wake at 6am with {energy}% energy.

late_warm_bed.text: You went to bed after midnight at {place}, under shelter with a fire burning. The short night leaves you with {energy}% energy at 6am.

late_unheated_bed.text: You went to bed after midnight at {place}, under shelter but without a burning fire. You wake at 6am with {energy}% energy.

exposed_bed.text: The bed at {place} was exposed, without shelter. You wake at 6am with {energy}% energy.

ground.text: You slept without a bed at {place}. The rough sleep restores you to {energy}% energy at 6am.

_provisions: Eat and drink from carried supplies at this hunger/thirst; warn once per shortage.

provisions.title: Supplies running low
provisions.hunger: You have no ready-to-eat food left. Eat soon, or you will collapse.
provisions.thirst: You have no drinking water left. Drink soon, or you will collapse. Find fresh water or refill your can.
provisions.both: You have no ready-to-eat food or drinking water left. Eat and drink soon, or you will collapse. Prepare food and find fresh water.

preparation.text: Raw fish and meat cannot be eaten. You can build a simple drying rack to process them, or cook them over a fire. A drying rack takes 12 hours; cook over a fire if you need food sooner.

_ending: the end screen (death is permanent): {time} and {day} in survived, {cause} in cause

ending.title: The journal ends
survived: You lasted {time} on the island, until day {day}.
You survived {time}. The journal stops on day {day}.

_journal: lines the engine writes itself; {place} is the name of the place

wayOpens: Now you know the way to {place}.

_tasks: the note when a task is done: {task}; what changed: {item} {where} {place} {action}
_newPlace: a place new on the map ({place}): text under the finding that opened it (or a note titled title), and go, the button that walks there

newPlace.title: A new place
newPlace.text: A new place is on your map: {place}. You can walk there now, or later from the map.

_tools: tool tags: the label next to the items that have it, and what a { "tool": tag } requirement asks for (without naming an item)

fire_starter.label: fire starter
fire_starter.needs: something to make a fire with

_menus: the craft and build menus: the button next to look around, the pop-up's title, its text, and the text when it offers nothing

craft.title: Craft
text: What could you make with your hands and what you carry?
You turn over what you have. What could it become?
empty: Nothing comes to mind that you could make yet.
You turn over what you have. Nothing to make from it yet.

build.title: Build
text: You look around for a place to build.
empty: There is nothing you could build here yet.
You look around. Nothing to build here, not yet.

timers.name: fire
expireLog: The fire goes out. Only embers now.
The last flame dies. The embers glow, then fade.
The fire is out. A thin thread of smoke.
